description.value: McArthur Creek is a hike-in backcountry campground in Yoho National Park, accessible by trail only with no road access for cyclists; a mandatory backcountry permit and advance reservations are required for peak season. High-elevation terrain means snow can persist into late June and wintry conditions are possible any time of year.
